certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Beamery has been continually ISO 27001-certified since 2020.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II — An independent assessment issued annually that evaluates controls systems against AICPA Trust Services Criteria. Certifications and Reports: SOC 2 Type II, SOC 2 Type 2 Bridge Letter

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
certifications.proof_quote: Beamery, the AI platform for workforce transformation, has announced it has achieved ISO 42001 certification, the world's first international standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: Beamery is in full compliance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and has specific tools and processes to help customers in their own compliance with GDPR requirements.

certifications.name: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: Beamery is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (EU-U.S. DPF) and the UK Extension and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: CCPA Compliant
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA COMPLIANT — Compliant with California Consumer Privacy Act to protect personal information across the US.

certifications.name: TRUSTe Enterprise Privacy Certification (TrustArc)
certifications.proof_quote: Obtaining this certification is a key milestone for Beamery. It reinforces our commitment and investment in our privacy practices globally. (Nicolette Nowak, DPO, Beamery) — Certified January 2022, recertified annually.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: CSA STAR Level 1 — Beamery self-assesses biennially against the Cloud Security Alliance framework, with results verifiable at their registry.

certifications.name: Warden AI Third-Party Bias Assurance
certifications.proof_quote: Beamery uses Warden AI to provide third-party assurance over its AI systems. Our platform continuously audits for bias and other risks, giving ongoing visibility into fairness, compliance, and system behavior.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA certification or BAA offering found on the security page, trust center, or privacy policy. Beamery serves HR/talent use cases, not healthcare.

privacy.ai_training_note: Beamery explicitly does not use PII or customer data to train AI. Models were trained on approximately 2 million public people profiles (roles, skills, education, industries). Customer data processed as a processor/service provider is handled only per customer instructions. The privacy policy notes that product improvement and analytics may include AI model training for data where Beamery acts as a controller (its own website visitors), not enterprise customer data.
privacy.data_region: EU or US at customer election; data may also be stored in UK, Australia, and countries where affiliates operate

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual; Pentest Report 2025 available on trust center under NDA/access request

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Self-hosted program (not HackerOne/Bugcrowd); submission via info.beamery.com/bug-bounty-program; reward amounts not disclosed; contact security@beamery.com

security.name: Access control
security.value: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC); least-privilege principle; data access to customer data is restricted

security.name: Employee security training
security.value: Annual security, privacy, and compliance training; background checks on all employees

security.name: Disaster recovery
security.value: Annual DR test; RTO 24 hours; Disaster Recovery Test Results 2025 available on trust center

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Google LLC (cloud, analytics, Gemini), AWS, Cloudflare (CDN, DDoS protection), Twilio (SMS), SendGrid (email), Segment (analytics), Textkernel/Sovren (resume parsing)

security.name: AI bias auditing
security.value: Monthly continuous audits by Warden AI across sex, race/ethnicity, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation. June 2026 audit: 58 Clear, 0 Concern. NYC Local Law 144 and EU AI Act compliance audits completed.

security.name: AI turn on/off
security.value: Customers have the ability to turn AI features on or off within the platform

products.name: Workforce Intelligence Suite
products.data_scope: Processes employee and candidate skills data, workforce composition, market insights. EU or US data residency at customer election.
products.notes: Core analytics layer aggregating internal HR data with external market signals. Used by executives and HR leaders for strategic planning.

products.name: Agentic AI Consultant
products.data_scope: Processes workforce data and HR instructions to automate talent decisions. Same data residency options as core platform.
products.notes: Emerging agentic AI layer; governed by Beamery's Acceptable Use Policy for Generative AI (documented in trust center).

products.name: Talent CRM (Sourcing and Matching)
products.data_scope: Candidate PII, resume data, communication history. EU or US at customer election. Resume parsing by Textkernel/Sovren subprocessor.
products.notes: AI Talent Match feature audited monthly by Warden AI for bias. Model trained only on public profiles, not customer candidate data.

products.name: Talent Marketing and Career Sites
products.data_scope: Candidate engagement data, job application data, chatbot interactions. Segment used for analytics.
products.notes: Includes chatbot functionality and candidate-facing career portals. Candidates can see match scores and career path recommendations.

products.name: Task Intelligence / Skills Intelligence
products.data_scope: Job descriptions, skills ontology, role data. Used to power skills-based hiring and workforce planning.
products.notes: Converts unstructured job descriptions into skills frameworks. Integrates with Workday and SAP SuccessFactors.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise SaaS (contract-based, demo required; no self-serve pricing listed publicly)
compare.data_residency: EU or US at customer election (customer chooses on instance setup)
